[[Thorn Devourer]]s are members of the [[Devourer]] species, which can attack at range by shooting projectiles with their tails. They can be found in the [[Maguuma Jungle]], preferring the arid areas in that region. Like most Devourers they often hide beneath the surface of the ground to ambush unsuspecting prey.
